## Scope and source notes

FAQ pp11–12 confirms v2 via CitiDirect, CitiConnect for Files and API, including event-driven 054 API. V8 CGI-MP files available since 2023 for specific branches; branch eligibility requires confirmation. Separate FINplus v8 service is eligible-FI only. MyStandards samples require access; API request examples are not original CAMT statement files. No open redistribution license established. These global sources do not enumerate US-booked account eligibility. API reference formatName labels include v2; its inconsistent intraday naming does not change the FAQ business meanings.

No open redistribution licence established. Consult the publisher before republishing originals.
